product.category: Markdown 阅读与笔记工作台
product.tagline: 把本地 Markdown 内容变成可持续阅读和记录的工作区。
product.description: 扫描本地内容库，统一管理书籍和笔记项目，支持阅读、编辑、分栏、标题跳转、进度保存、高亮和搜索。
nonGoals: 替代在线知识库或多人协作编辑器
把本地正文上传到远程服务
在没有用户选择的情况下修改原始 Markdown 文件

facts.label: 阅读方式
facts.value: 阅读 / 编辑 / 分栏

capabilities.title: 内容库扫描
capabilities.body: 扫描用户明确选择的本地目录，发现 Markdown 文件并建立可检索的内容入口。

capabilities.title: 阅读工作区
capabilities.body: 在阅读视图中查看正文、标题结构和当前位置，保持适合长文阅读的连续上下文。

capabilities.title: 阅读与编辑并行
capabilities.body: 按需切换阅读、编辑和分栏视图，在理解内容和修改 Markdown 之间保持顺畅切换。

capabilities.title: 进度与高亮
capabilities.body: 保存阅读进度、当前视图和高亮记录，让下一次打开时可以继续上次的工作。

capabilities.title: Agent CLI
capabilities.body: 通过稳定 JSON CLI 扫描工作区、读写文档、管理项目、进度和高亮。

workflow.label: 扫描
workflow.title: 选择本地内容库
workflow.body: 从示例或用户明确选择的目录开始扫描，确认内容范围后再建立项目。

workflow.label: 整理
workflow.title: 创建书籍或笔记项目
workflow.body: 将多文档 Markdown 内容整理为 book 或 note 项目，保留原始目录边界。

workflow.label: 阅读
workflow.title: 在结构中连续阅读
workflow.body: 通过标题结构跳转，记录进度并在需要时切换到编辑或分栏视图。

workflow.label: 记录
workflow.title: 保存高亮与下一步
workflow.body: 把重要片段保存为高亮记录，并通过 CLI 或桌面端继续后续整理。

boundary.title: 内容留在本机，修改范围由用户选择
boundary.body: rReadNote 是本地优先的 Markdown 阅读与笔记工具，不是在线同步服务。它只读取或写入用户明确选择的目录，示例和截图使用虚构的内容标题与文本。

website.releaseSummary: 首个公开预览版覆盖本地 Markdown 扫描、书籍与笔记项目、阅读/编辑/分栏视图、进度、高亮和稳定 JSON CLI。

cli.highRiskPolicy: 写入 Markdown、创建项目和保存高亮前必须由用户明确提供路径或项目目标，CLI 输出不应泄露正文以外的本机敏感路径。

runtime.configPath: 系统应用数据目录中的 rreadnote 配置
runtime.storagePath: 本机应用数据目录中的项目索引、阅读状态和备份
runtime.secretPolicy: 应用不保存账户凭据；公开示例、截图和测试内容使用虚构文本，不读取未选择的个人目录。

product.tagline: Turn local Markdown into a durable reading and note-taking workspace.
product.description: Scan a local library, organize book and note projects, read, edit, split panes, save progress, capture highlights, and search Markdown content.
nonGoals: Replace an online knowledge base or collaborative editor
Upload local document bodies to a remote service
Modify Markdown files without an explicitly selected target

capabilities.title: Library scanning
capabilities.body: Scan an explicitly selected local directory and create searchable Markdown entry points.

capabilities.title: Reading workspace
capabilities.body: Read documents with heading structure and position context designed for long-form continuity.

capabilities.title: Read and edit together
capabilities.body: Switch between reading, editing, and split views as you move from understanding to revision.

capabilities.title: Progress and highlights
capabilities.body: Save reading position, view state, and highlights so the next session can resume.

capabilities.title: Agent CLI
capabilities.body: Scan workspaces, read and write documents, and manage projects, progress, and highlights through stable JSON commands.

workflow.label: Scan
workflow.title: Choose a local library
workflow.body: Start with an example or explicitly selected directory and confirm the content scope.

workflow.label: Organize
workflow.title: Create a book or note project
workflow.body: Group Markdown documents into a book or note project while preserving the source directory boundary.

workflow.label: Read
workflow.title: Read continuously through structure
workflow.body: Jump by headings, save progress, and switch to editing or split view when needed.

workflow.label: Record
workflow.title: Save highlights and next steps
workflow.body: Capture important passages and continue organizing them from the desktop app or CLI.

boundary.title: Content stays local and edits stay explicit
boundary.body: rReadNote is a local-first Markdown reader and note tool, not an online sync service. It reads and writes only explicitly selected directories, and its examples use fictional titles and text.

website.releaseSummary: The first public preview covers local Markdown scanning, book and note projects, read/edit/split views, progress, highlights, and a stable JSON CLI.
